text: I had a friend named Javier who also happened to be a co-worker of mine. He worked on first shift and I am on second shift. There is a thirty minute overlap between shift changes, so I start work while first shift is still there. I realized Javier had been falsifying information on a product label code for the entire shift and also messed up an order where there should have been an allergen warning on the product. It turns out he had realized the mistake halfway through his shift, but he ultimately decided against putting all of the product on hold for inspection because he did not want to get in trouble. He told me this when I confronted him about the mistake once I’d caught it. He asked me not to tell the supervisor. If I didn't report Javier, I would put the lives of our customers at risk. But I I struggled deeply with reporting him, because I knew Javier has a family and two children, and he would definitely be fired if I reported his actions.
